methods.label: Savings per kilometer
methods.explanation: The emissions saved per kilometer are \(0.2-0.05=0.15\) kg. Over 10 km, the total emissions saved are \(10\times0.15=1.5\) kg.
methods.levelReason: Decimal subtraction and multiplication by an integer are elementary arithmetic prerequisites available before Grade 7.
